notes.title: Update v1.64!
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers!

Small update with changes to some fighters’ abilities.
Here they are:
- Thoveas [Scout], in addition to always being able to move regardless of the number of enemies present, the "Inspect" action is now free for him.
- Daranath [Thief], in addition to multiplying gold gains by 1.5, now has a 25% chance to inflict the "Poisoned" status on an enemy.

Other changes:
- n the list of collectible items, fixed an item that was incorrectly referenced.
- Minor optimizations.

And don’t forget, the sequel, "Kingdoms of Dice," is available:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3774030/Kingdoms_of_Dice__The_Elonia_Chronicles/

You can also find both games in a bundle with a 25% discount:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56700/The_Elonia_Chronicles_Collection/

Enjoy! ^^

notes.title: Update 1.62 and Announcement!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! ^^[/p][p][/p][p]A small update to improve the game’s usability:[/p][list][*][p]You can now click on a fighter’s portrait to center the camera on them.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The action menu remains visible when moving the camera.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And I’m thrilled to introduce the new game in the Elonia Chronicles universe: "[i]Kingdoms of Dice"[/i]![/p][p][i]"Kingdoms of Dice"[/i] takes place after the events of "[i]Fate And Destiny"[/i].[/p][p]The game immerses you in a heroic fantasy world inspired by dice-based board games.[/p][p]Continue to explore the Elonia Chronicles through 4 iconic factions, across 4 scripted campaigns.[/p][p]To succeed in your adventure, upgrade your band of fighters, purchase bonus cards,[/p][p]and roll your resource dice to activate each of your warriors’ abilities.[/p][p]The dice of fate await you![/p][p]More details:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3774030/Kingdoms_of_Dice__The_Elonia_Chronicles/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Update v1.6 - New content!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The new update (v1.6) for "Fate And Destiny - The Elonia Chronicles" is now live.
What's included:
- 3 new maps for Skirmish mode (bringing the total to 8 maps for even more replayability)
- Rebalancing of difficulty levels
- Various improvements (visuals, translations, etc)

Enjoy! ^^

notes.title: Minor update v1.51 !
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A small update to improve the game.
What's included:
- Fixed a minor, non-blocking bug that could trigger under certain conditions during movement.
- The "End Turn" button now displays correctly after the "Medication" action.
- Dialogues can now be skipped with the "Space" key.
- The pause menu now appears with the "Escape" key.
- The camera can now be moved by placing the mouse on the screen edges.

Enjoy! ^^

notes.title: Discover the content of “Fate And Destiny”!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A few days before the release of "Fate And Destiny - The Elonia Chronicles", here’s a quick overview of the game:
- Campaign Mode with over 10 hours of gameplay, including 15 story-driven chapters.
- Choices during the adventure to unlock 3 different endings.
- 6 heroes to unlock.
- Skirmish Mode (to be unlocked), offering a mini-adventure through 3 dungeons with high replayability.
- Object collection.
- "Jukebox" Mode to replay the game’s soundtrack.

I hope this gets you excited!

Don’t hesitate to add the game to your wishlist, it helps a lot!

See you on May 7 for the game’s release.

Enjoy! ^^
